subject: Web Development
title: Script Blocking and Async Loading
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Script Blocking and Async Loading.

hook.text: A single script tag can freeze the entire page from rendering. Here's why.

buildup.text: When the parser hits a script, it must stop, download, and execute it before continuing.

discovery.text: Scripts might modify the DOM, so the browser can't safely continue parsing in parallel.

twist.text: The async and defer attributes changed everything. Scripts load without blocking the parser.

climax.text: One attribute turned script loading from a bottleneck into a background task.

punchline.text: Async scripts let the page breathe.

quiz.question: What does the 'async' attribute do on a script tag?
